title: Wescraft: Bleach
description: This mod adds an early-game way of repairing armor by washing.
body:
**Wescraft: Bleach** is a mod from the Wescraft Project that adds an early-game way to repair armor by washing.

### How does it work?

Start off by crafting a **washing board**. This product, along with a **washing tub**, will allow you to slowly repair your armor **by hand**. Sick of washing your armor manually? Craft a washing machine to automatically repair your armor using **soap** and patience (rate of repair is configurable).

### Plans to expand the mod:
  - Add drying machines
    - Make it so armor get wet from washing machines (less useful than dry armor)
    - Add lint (maybe)
  - Add better washing machines
  - Add bleach (of course!)
  - Make a tool washing machine

Visit the **discord server** to report bugs or suggestions!
